strings.name: Noubar Afeyan
strings.role: Flagship founder and CEO; Moderna cofounder and chairman
strings.summary: Born in Beirut to an Armenian family, American-Canadian bioengineering entrepreneur Noubar Afeyan organizes research and company creation through Flagship. He helped build Moderna and cofounded Aurora’s humanitarian initiative. Scientific and vaccine achievements depend on teams.
strings.coverageNote: Reviewed through November 17, 2026. Corporate awards differ from personal honors, honorary doctorates from research degrees, and commitments from spending. Conflicting early Flagship founding years are not resolved to one precise year.
strings.influence.rationale: Helped create Moderna and other life-science companies, advancing platform biotechnology entrepreneurship and the commercialization of medical innovation.
strings.facts.f1.label: Engineering education
strings.facts.f1.value: McGill engineering bachelor’s degree in 1983; MIT biochemical engineering PhD in 1987. McGill’s 2022 science doctorate was honorary.
strings.facts.f2.label: Teaching
strings.facts.f2.value: MIT Sloan senior lecturer from 2000 to 2016; taught at Harvard Business School until 2020. These are former roles.
strings.highlights.h1.title: Research and company creation
strings.highlights.h1.text: Connects scientific teams, platform ideas and company building. Moderna chairman is distinct from CEO and does not imply sole invention of mRNA technology.
strings.highlights.h2.title: Humanitarian cooperation
strings.highlights.h2.text: Cofounded Aurora with partners to support frontline humanitarians; founding the initiative is not winning its prize.
strings.timeline.t1.title: London company-creation lab announced
strings.timeline.t1.text: Flagship commits an initial £100 million. Hiring and partner funding remain plans; its London office opened in 2023.
strings.timeline.t2.title: Accepts national medal for Moderna
strings.timeline.t2.text: With Hamilton Bennett, receives the National Medal of Technology and Innovation for Moderna; the company is the recipient, not him personally.
strings.timeline.t3.title: McGill honorary science doctorate
strings.timeline.t3.text: University recap confirms conferment at spring convocation; distinct from his 1987 research doctorate.
strings.timeline.t4.title: Cofounds Aurora initiative
strings.timeline.t4.text: Launches with Vartan Gregorian and Ruben Vardanyan, honoring Armenian Genocide survivors and those who saved them.
strings.timeline.t5.title: Becomes Moderna chairman
strings.timeline.t5.text: 2026 proxy records director since 2010 and chairman since 2012; not CEO tenure.
strings.timeline.t6.title: PerSeptive joins Perkin-Elmer
strings.timeline.t6.text: University and company biographies record the transaction and subsequent senior management work; no inferred personal proceeds.
strings.timeline.t7.title: Helps found PerSeptive Biosystems
strings.timeline.t7.text: Enters bio-instrumentation entrepreneurship in the year of his PhD, later serving as chairman and CEO.
strings.timeline.t8.title: Completes McGill undergraduate education
strings.timeline.t8.text: Earns engineering bachelor’s degree, then pursues biochemical engineering doctoral research at MIT.
